brief: Scaffold the Python package '${pkg}' under ${root} into a well-formed, importable shape with a passing smoke test.

work_packages.title: Package layout exists
work_packages.instructions: Create the package directory '${pkg}' under ${root} with an __init__.py so it is a real Python package. The package name '${pkg}' must be a valid Python identifier. Do not put code in __init__.py beyond what a clean package needs.

work_packages.title: Package imports cleanly
work_packages.instructions: Make 'import ${pkg}' succeed from the project root ${root} with no import-time errors. Resolve missing dependencies and broken imports inside the package.

work_packages.title: Smoke test passes
work_packages.instructions: Add a smoke test at ${root}/tests/test_${pkg}_smoke.py that imports ${pkg} and asserts at least one basic property (e.g. that it imports and exposes a __name__). Make it pass under pytest.

checklist.assert: a smoke test file for ${pkg} exists
